Mr/Mrs. {{doc.applicant_name}}
OFFER LETTER
Dear {{doc.applicant_name}}
Congratulation!
With reference to your application and subsequent interview you had with us, we are pleased to offer you the position of {{doc.designation}} in our organization on the terms and conditions discussed during the interview.

You will be stationed at {{frappe.db.get_value("Job Applicant",doc.job_applicant,"custom_location")}}.

Your remuneration as discussed and finalized is Rs. {{doc.custom_ctc_per_annum}} /- Per Annum, the detail breakup of the same is attached as Annexure-A along with this letter.

A detailed appointment letter will be given to you after you join us.
Kindly bring along 3 recent passport size photograph and all original certificates of education and experience at the time of joining.
You are required to join the company on or before {{frappe.db.get_value("Job Applicant",doc.job_applicant,"custom_expected_doj").strftime('%d %B %Y')}}.
You have been selected because we believe you have the potential and the desire to meet the high standards of excellence that are the hall marks of {{doc.company}}. We know you have hopes and aspirations of your own, & surely, expectations from us as well. We consider it our obligation on our part to:
  1. treat you fairly & with respect
  2. provide open two way channels of communication
  3. offer suitable recognition for your dedication and excellence of performance

Ours is a growing company, continuously improving and expanding.
We wish to see you grow along with us.
Looking forward to your joining our organization.

Thanking you,
For,Minix Holdings Private Limited.

Dr. H. C. Panjikar
Group Head - Human Capital & Administration

PS :- Please revert with your confirmation of acceptance of this offer letter within two weeks time from date of issue; failing to which the offer letter will be deemed withdrawn.
P-BS
Annexure A

Minix Holdings Private Limited
Mr/Mrs. {{doc.applicant_name}}
